name: OeIntegration_15min
description: Short OE-integration test, ~15 min. Purpose: confirm the BLE OE sensor's mic captures land in /oe_samples without changing the sweep skip count, before committing to a 13 h run. Motor turns (500-1200 rpm, open loop) so the sensor sees a running bearing; no temperature setpoints, so the heater stays out of it. NOTE: the UL probe is detached (ticket 0015), so CHAN1 records a normal-looking but meaningless trace in this run - it is not a data run. SP/CHAN3 volt_offset is 5.0 because the slip ring sits on its ~5 V excitation pedestal; measured 2026-08-29 the channel spans 1.8-8.4 V. The old 8.0/0.0 window (-4 to +4 V) clipped more than half of it. Runs before 2026-08-29 were taken with the scope probe's GROUND LEAD DETACHED, which removed the DC reference and is why SP looked like it sat at 0 V and carried no rotation signal - see ticket 0038.
